education_level.instructions: From state.cv, choose the highest completed qualification level relevant to facilities management or building maintenance as of state.reference_date. Do not count short safety courses as academic qualifications. Do not infer an award from attendance alone.

criteria.secondary_or_lower: Secondary school qualifications or lower, with no higher relevant completed qualification.
criteria.vocational_technical: Relevant vocational or technical qualification below higher education, such as UK NVQ Level 3; not a university degree.
criteria.short_cycle_higher: Relevant short-cycle higher education, such as an associate degree, HND or foundation degree; below bachelor's level.
criteria.bachelors: Relevant completed bachelor's degree or equivalent.
criteria.masters: Relevant completed master's degree or equivalent.
criteria.not_stated: No completed qualification within the stated scope is evidenced.

certification.instructions: Does state.cv name IOSH Managing Safely as a credential held or a course completed? Equivalent names: IOSH Managing Safely; Institution of Occupational Safety and Health Managing Safely. Do not count generic safety duties, preparation or planned study. Do not assess expiry, authenticity or current validity.

criteria.present: The named credential or an equivalent name is stated as held or completed, including an entry under certifications.
criteria.not_mentioned: The CV does not evidence that the named credential is held or completed.

experience_years.instructions: From employment dates in state.cv, choose the total documented duration of facilities or building maintenance work as of state.reference_date. Include hands-on maintenance, facilities support and maintenance supervision. Count overlapping periods once. Present means state.reference_date. Use only dates tied to relevant work, not a general summary claim. Zero evidenced duration belongs to under_1, not proof of no experience.

criteria.under_1: Less than one year of documented relevant work, including zero evidenced duration.
criteria.1_to_under_3: At least one but less than three years of documented relevant work.
criteria.3_to_under_5: At least three but less than five years of documented relevant work.
criteria.5_to_under_8: At least five but less than eight years of documented relevant work.
criteria.8_plus: At least eight years of documented relevant work.

skill_coverage.instructions: How many of these four items are explicitly mentioned or unambiguously described in state.cv: CMMS (computerised/computerized maintenance management system); Microsoft Excel; contractor management; welding? Count each supplied item once. Basic exposure or a skills-list mention counts. General maintenance does not establish welding. This is document coverage, not proficiency.

criteria.0: None of the four supplied items is evidenced.
criteria.1: Exactly one of the four supplied items is evidenced.
criteria.2: Exactly two of the four supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.3: Exactly three of the four supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.4: All four supplied items are evidenced.

skill_evidence.instructions: What is the strongest explicit evidence for CMMS (computerised/computerized maintenance management system) in state.cv? Classify the evidence context, not ability. A tools-list mention alone does not establish application or professional use. Do not assume an asset register or maintenance schedule used a CMMS unless the CV links them.

criteria.not_mentioned: No identifiable mention or unambiguous description of CMMS.
criteria.stated_or_studied: CMMS is listed, claimed or studied, without a concrete application example.
criteria.applied: CMMS is explicitly used in a concrete nonprofessional project, practical training, volunteering or other nonprofessional activity; no explicit professional use.
criteria.used_professionally: The CV explicitly links CMMS use to professional work.
